name: Downed Revive
description: The second chance between 'health hit zero' and 'out of the match'. Intercepts the lethal blow into a downed state with a bleed-out timer, and owns the revive channel: range, duration, interruption on damage. It does not heal — a completed revive applies a fixed reviveHealthFraction and hands the entity back to combat.damage_resolver's authority, because two components writing health is how players end up immortal. Solo modes simply never enable it. Its presence in a squad match is what turns 'finish the downed player' into a decision — spend the ammo and exposure, or let the clock do it — instead of an automatic.

inputs.name: bleedOutSeconds
inputs.description: Time from downed to fully dead. This is the rescue window and the tension budget in one number; under 15 seconds revives never happen, over 60 the downed state loses its teeth.

inputs.name: reviveChannelSeconds
inputs.description: Uninterrupted channel time to complete a revive. Long enough that reviving mid-fight is a real commitment — the channel, not the bleed-out, is what the defending team shoots at.

inputs.name: reviveHealthFraction
inputs.description: Health restored on a successful revive, as a fraction of max. Deliberately low: a revived player should rejoin the fight as a liability being protected, not a reset button.

inputs.name: reviveRange
inputs.description: Maximum distance between reviver and downed player. Contact-range by default so the revive physically commits the rescuer next to a target everyone is already aiming at.

inputs.name: damageInterruptsRevive
inputs.description: Whether damage to the reviver breaks the channel. True, because an uninterruptible revive turns the mechanic into a scripted trade instead of a contested play.

outputs.name: isDowned
outputs.description: True from the lethal blow until revived or bled out. Movement and weapon systems gate on this — a downed player crawls, and nothing here decides how crawling works.

outputs.name: bleedOutRemaining
outputs.description: Seconds left before death. The HUD's countdown and the killer's decision both read this same number.

outputs.name: reviveProgress
outputs.description: Channel completion, 0 to 1, for whoever is reviving this entity. Zero when no channel is active.
